cells.tense: The pen is here, and the page in front of you is still blank.
cells.act: let yourself be drawn before you choose
cells.ask: In a part of life where nothing is decided, follow the pull toward what might come, a little way, before you pick. Don't keep it or make it mean anything.
cells.core:
Nothing has landed yet where you are, and you can feel what might, without grabbing at it. That is the good version of this, and it is working. You aren't forcing a feeling into a decision, and you aren't shutting the door before anything knocks. Most people can't do that.

More could be gathered here than you're letting in. Follow one pull toward what might be felt, before you decide it—just far enough to see what it is. You don't have to keep it. You don't have to make it mean anything. The drawing-toward is yours, and going a little way is how the possibility gets a body. Let what might be felt have one piece you actually put a hand near.
cells.sheetLine: You're open before anything has arrived, and that is the gift.
cells.verb: opening before there is anything to open onto
cells.place: the moment before choice collapses everything into one thing

cells.tense: The future is arriving, and you are already braced against what it hasn't yet brought.
cells.act: bring the directed work to its full standing
cells.ask: Choose the unfinished piece you keep forcing forward, and bring it to a standing place you can walk away from without it falling. Just that piece.
cells.core:
Where you are, everything is still possible, and the future is being clamped onto it before the moment can arrive by itself. Each thing gets its outcome pre-decided, its shape forced to a finish, and the plainness of not-yet is gone. You've made it come before it came.

This is a will that needs the thing standing before the thing has grown—the legacy insisted on before it exists. Bring the piece you're forcing to a full standing, a piece you can finish and set down, and leave everything else where it is. Finishing here isn't proof of anything; it's a way out of bracing. When the work stands without your hands on it, they're free to receive what comes next.
cells.sheetLine: You're closing the future before it can arrive.
cells.verb: opening before there is anything to open onto
cells.place: the moment before choice collapses everything into one thing

cells.tense: You are standing at a door that is already behind you.
cells.act: carry what the spark became to its full size
cells.ask: Take what began when it was all possibility and carry it to the size it actually became—one real step toward its real shape.
cells.core:
You can still feel what this was meant to be, and nothing is arriving. What started as open possibility is stuck at the starting line, with the door already shut behind it. The openness is there; it's anchored to a moment that has passed.

What wants to move is the spark carried forward, not the spark re-lived. Take what began when it was all possibility and carry it to the size it actually became—one step toward its real shape, now. Beginner's mind isn't lost; it's just past a door you can walk back through. Finishing what potential became isn't a verdict on the past. It's the next move.
cells.sheetLine: You're holding a possibility that's already become something real.
cells.verb: opening before there is anything to open onto
cells.place: the moment before choice collapses everything into one thing

cells.tense: The pen is down in a room where you are already writing.
cells.act: let the exchange with someone run both ways
cells.ask: With one person, give something true and accept what they offer at its real size—let one exchange run both directions without keeping score.
cells.core:
Someone across from you is already in an exchange with you—giving what you have, taking what they offer—and you'd say it just happens. The fairness is flowing, and no one's name is on it, least of all yours.

The earliest form of this line is a fair trade with another person, and it's yours to bring back into view. With one person, give something true and accept what they give back at its real size; let one exchange run both ways without a tally. That's the plainest shape of what you already do. Naming the exchange as yours is what turns the open moment into something you're making rather than watching.
cells.sheetLine: You're holding open possibility for both of you, and calling it no one's work.
cells.verb: opening before there is anything to open onto

attempts.check: The record does not say the person has been withholding feeling deliberately or that their hearts have been closed—so I narrow to what the seat can show: some part of their life is before choice, and the capacity for felt awareness is what operates there. The reader could reasonably say 'I don't do this all the time; it's just this one area that hasn't opened yet,' and they would be right—that is exactly what 'in one part of a life' allows. The asks survive being wrong: each is a small act of the medicine's own line, not a verdict on what is happening, so if the read misses, the act still teaches them something. The sentence that would serve me more than them is any line that says what is 'really' underneath the person's account, so I have struck those.
